headline: Diffusion Engineers reports Company Secretary Chanchal Jaiswal's resignation effective November 2026
summary: Diffusion Engineers Limited has informed the stock exchange about the resignation of Ms. CS Chanchal Jaiswal from her role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Her departure is scheduled to take effect from November 30, 2026. Retail investors should note that changes in key managerial personnel are routine corporate governance updates.
whats_next: Appointment of a new Company Secretary before November 30, 2026
why_it_matters: Routine leadership change with no direct impact on share price
